voice_description: Native Japanese, standard Japanese. An adult female inner-voice character in a dramatic fantasy anime. Cool, composed and cautionary, a low intimate voice with a slightly dry edge. Brief reminders carry weight and restraint, never a monster voice or comic caricature. Studio-quality recording.
